responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exports the colorization and quoting helpers implemented in m2color.cc. It defines the foreign interface used by gm2 diagnostics code to obtain GCC’s named color escape sequences and host-appropriate quote characters, allowing Modula-2-side formatting code to match GCC diagnostic presentation.
same_name_distinction: This file is the Modula-2 foreign-definition interface for the color adapter, declaring the quote and color escape helpers with Modula-2 pointer types. Unlike m2color.h it targets Modula-2 callers, and unlike m2color.cc it contains no forwarding code to GCC diagnostics.
